product_overview: DataAnalyzer is a web-based single-page application designed to enable users to upload data files, inspect and analyze their contents through automated schema detection, sample previewing, and generate executable Python scripts for data analysis with visualization outputs. It integrates a React/Tailwind/Bun frontend with a FastAPI Python backend to provide an end-to-end workflow from data ingestion to interactive results exploration.
core_goals: Provide a seamless file upload experience with automatic format detection and manual override.
Enable deterministic data sampling with customizable strategies and preview of samples and inferred schema.
Generate Python analysis scripts automatically using AI-assisted code generation or static templates.
Execute generated scripts in a managed backend environment capturing real-time logs and output artifacts.
Display rich interactive results including visual charts and textual insights in a responsive gallery.
Maintain smooth progressive user experience with clear states, accessibility, and persistence of session settings.
Ensure robust frontend-backend integration through typed APIs and streaming feedback for responsiveness.
Facilitate efficient development and testing through comprehensive unit, integration, e2e, and contract tests.
key_features: File upload with multipart form handling and secure backend storage.
Data inspector module that detects file format, samples data deterministically (head/tail/random), infers data schema, and computes statistics (nulls, cardinality).

Interactive frontend panels: File chooser, Inspect results with virtualized sample table, Script preview with copy/download, Execution logs streaming and config, Results gallery with visualizations and reports.
Automated Python script generation using OpenAI API integration or fallback static templates with script preview capability.
Script execution environment that runs analysis scripts and collects multiple artifacts including HTML reports and images.
Frontend implemented with React 19, Bun, Tailwind CSS 4, and Radix UI for accessibility and component design.
Backend implemented with FastAPI 3 and Python 3.12 leveraging numpy, pandas, pyarrow for efficient data processing.
Streaming backend logs and partial results support to ensure responsive UX during long running tasks.
Comprehensive test suite covering unit tests, integration tests with mocked HTTP API, end-to-end Playwright tests, and contract tests for frontend/backend payload compatibility.
user_flow_summary: User accesses the app and selects a data file to upload via the File page.
File is uploaded via multipart POST /api/upload and path is returned securely from backend.
User configures sampling strategy (head, tail, random), row limit, and seed for deterministic sampling.
Backend inspects the uploaded file and returns sample rows, inferred schema, and statistics via /api/inspect.
User previews the sample and schema in a virtualized table with inferred types and stats.
User triggers code generation which calls /api/generate to obtain a Python analysis script shown in read-only preview panel.
User configures execution settings (visualization library, output directory, CPU/memory hints) and runs the script via /api/execute.
Backend streams execution logs and upon completion returns artifacts (charts, HTML reports).
Frontend presents the results in a responsive gallery with interactive charts and links to detailed reports.
User can copy/download generated scripts and explore logs and outputs; session state is persisted for convenience.
validation_criteria: File uploads succeed and backend securely stores files with correct metadata returned.
Inspection reliably detects format, samples rows deterministically as configured, and returns accurate schema and statistics.
Generated Python scripts correspond to inspection results and user preferences; script preview matches backend output.
Script execution runs without errors, streams real-time logs, and produces expected artifacts files accessible to frontend.
Frontend components transition through defined states (idle → inspecting → generating → executing → succeeded/failure) appropriately with loading/error feedback.
All UI controls and navigation are accessible via keyboard and ARIA standards are met.
Performance is adequate: sample tables virtualize large row counts, logs stream immediately, and prompt recomposition is debounced.
Comprehensive automated test coverage passes: unit tests, integration with mocked backend, end-to-end scenarios, and contract tests ensuring frontend/backend compatibility.

features.name: Frontend HTTP client
features.description: Typed API client for upload, inspect, generate, execute and artifact URLs.

features.name: Frontend App shell
features.description: Root app renders File page; simple SPA wiring and styles.

features.name: Frontend pages
features.description: Feature pages: File upload, Inspect results, Script preview, Results gallery.

features.name: Frontend Bun server
features.description: Bun server serving index and proxying API to backend (runs on port 4371).

features.name: Frontend build pipeline
features.description: Custom Bun build with Tailwind plugin producing production assets in dist/.

features.name: Backend FastAPI server
features.description: ASGI app exposing /api/upload, /api/inspect, /api/generate, /api/execute and static /artifacts with CORS enabled (default port 8099).

features.name: Data inspector
features.description: Detects file format, samples rows deterministically, infers schema and stats.

features.name: Code generation
features.description: Generates analysis Python script using OpenAI when configured, else static template.

features.name: Script executor
features.description: Runs generated script with uv or python, captures stdout JSON or scans artifact directory.

features.name: CLI entrypoints
features.description: Typer CLI and ASGI factory wiring for server start and usage.
